gen-dafont-starborn-gf-ruda: Dreamy, ethereal Starborn scatters wide gaps between its letters, while Ruda keeps a wiry, single-stroke body with generous rounds. The real draw is Starborn's drifting space against Ruda's sturdy screen-friendly lowercase.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch keeps a clearly open lowercase e and a compact ascender gap, giving Starborn's spaced-out, dreamy letters something to lean on. Starborn dreams out loud; Sarpanch gets the actual reading done.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Ethereal Starborn leaves big gaps between letters, while Schibsted Grotesk gives its e and a open, tall bowls. Shrink Starborn and its dreamy gaps would simply vanish into the line.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sofia-sans: Starborn drifts along on big gaps between letters, with a heavy lowercase band that feels ethereal. Sofia Sans draws rounded, wire-like strokes with no swelling at all, keeping the text crisp beneath.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sono: Starborn floats, all dreamy gaps and a heavy lowercase band. Sono grounds it with lowercase that towers over its capitals, generous spacing and an a left ajar, so the lines breathe.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads bulky and marker-plain, with open gaps in every curve. Starborn does the drifting, ethereal part, spacing letters far apart, while Sulphur Point does the steady, no-fuss part.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-anek-bangla: Structural and striking, Stencilia leaves spacious gaps where its curves end. Anek Bangla brings wide, barely curled s curves, while Stencilia earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-anek-latin: Spacious gaps at the curve terminals give Stencilia its structural, striking look, with ascenders sitting compactly above the x-height. Shrink Stencilia and those gaps blur; Anek Latin's tall lowercase holds up.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-anek-malayalam: Structural Stencilia leaves spacious gaps at its curve terminals, while Anek Malayalam leaves almost no step from x-height to caps. Paragraphs would glide, since the curve tips never quite touch.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia keeps its rounds unlatched, like a hook left open, with capitals sitting only just above lowercase. Anek Odia then keeps a full page moving smoothly, a quiet partner for Stencilia's structural, striking shapes.
